notes: All values are ESTIMATES derived from public sources; vendors do not publish per-query figures for most models.
Units: energy in Wh; WUE in L/kWh (numerically identical to mL/Wh, so water_mL = energy_Wh * PUE * (wue_site + wue_grid)).
Values marked source='TODO' are placeholders that MUST be sourced before release; the engine will refuse to use them unless allowPlaceholders=true.

token_estimation.source: OpenAI tokenizer rule of thumb (~4 chars/token English). Heuristic; no tokenizer shipped to keep footprint small.

long_context.note: Energy scales with input tokens automatically; no extra multiplier applied.

image.source: Luccioni, Jernite, Strubell (2023) 'Power Hungry Processing' — mean 2.907 kWh per 1,000 images for SDXL-class models.

sources: Epoch AI (Feb 2025): GPT-4o typical query ≈ 0.3 Wh
Google (Aug 2025) Gemini Apps technical report: median text prompt 0.24 Wh, 0.26 mL water
OpenAI/S. Altman (Jun 2025): average query ≈ 0.34 Wh, ≈0.32 mL water

reasoning.note: 10x standard. Reasoning models emit thousands of hidden chain-of-thought tokens not visible to the listener.
